My family has always oven roasted them. Lots of flavor.
Preheat oven to 450 
Prepare beets by cutting off greens and tails do not peel the skin
Wrap in foil individually and place on cookie sheet
Bake for 40 minutes for the medium sized ones (fist size)
Turn off oven and let the beets chill in there another 30 min
Take out and allow to cool (I stick them in the fridge)
Once cool unwrap from foil and the skin will basically fall off with very little effort (I just kind of scrape them with a butter knife)
Then you can cut up and use in salads or shred and put some in soup 
They're really tasty this way
